title: These pink sugar cookies from the store are not it. It’s time to grow...
description: These pink sugar cookies from the store are not it. It’s time to grow up and make ‘em from scratch!!! #baking #sugarcookies #recipes
transcript: I think we all have to stop pretending like these pink-frosted sugar cookies from the grocery store taste good. Instead, let's make them from scratch. One sixth softened butter, three quarters cup sugar. Cream that together till it's nice and fluffy. Plop in an egg and a little too much vanilla. Mix it up and add in a third of a cup of sour cream. Sounds weird, just trust me. Then add in one and a half tablespoons of cornstarch, a half teaspoon of baking powder, a half teaspoon of baking soda, quarter teaspoon of cream and tartar, a pinch of salt, and one and three quarters cups of flour. Cover and let it chill for 30 minutes and whip up that frosting. I just made a classic butter cream. Cool the chilled dough into balls, give them a little pat, pop that in the oven at 325 for like 10 minutes. Once they're cooled, the last thing to do is assemble those delicious cookies. These will top anything you can get at the grocery store. Sorry, not sorry.
